stimulus.description: A student measures the capacitance $C$ of a parallel-plate capacitor with vacuum between its two identical square plates, each of area $A=100\text{ cm}^{2}$ at several plate separations $d$.

parts.label: A
parts.prompt: Describe an experimental procedure to collect the data for the capacitance as a function of the plate separation. Include the equipment and the measurements, how the independent variable is changed, and one way to reduce the uncertainty in the separation.
